youtube.title: Why Did Xerox Let Steve Jobs Into PARC?
youtube.description:
In 1979 Xerox let Steve Jobs and a team from Apple into its Palo Alto Research Center, PARC, in return for the right to buy Apple shares. Inside they saw the Alto, a computer with a mouse, windows and a network, years before anyone could buy one. Why did Xerox open the door, and why did it never turn its own invention into a hit?

This documentary follows the copier empire that funded PARC, the 1977 choices that kept the Alto in the lab, the two December 1979 demos, the Star that cost $16,595, the Macintosh that cost $2,495, and the 1989 lawsuit that came too late. It also shows why the famous 'heist' story is incomplete, and why the tour was still the decision that cost Xerox the computer age.

{CHAPTERS}
